products.name: DeepSeek
products.note: Open-weight MoE; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
DeepSeek AI (深度求索) is a Chinese AI research company that describes itself as focused on researching foundational models and technologies for general artificial intelligence. The company's stated mission, rendered in its own Chinese-language tagline, translates roughly to "exploring uncharted territory." It publishes its models as open-weight releases and offers API access alongside web and app interfaces.

The company's primary product is DeepSeek, a chat and general-purpose large language model built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Its site references several released models including DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-R1, and a newly announced DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the last of which the company says brings significantly improved agent capabilities and support for a Responses API and Codex integration, available across its web, app, and API platforms. The held facts note that cross-border data review is advised for users of the product.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
